Basic setup
Put a little moisture on your left tragus.
Clip the earpiece there and run the cable over and behind your ear.
Turn it on and slowly increase the level until you feel a light tingling sensation. 
During the session
Keep the sensation pleasant — not painful.
If it fades, increase the level slightly. If it gets too strong, lower it. 
You can sit, relax, or do normal activities while using it.
Best routine

Morning is ideal, or split it between morning and evening.
